cases.name: get_leave_balance omits optional year and uses default current context year
cases.objective: Verify get_leave_balance accepts a request without the optional year argument and resolves the balance using the default year behavior.
preconditions: A valid employee identity is available to the harness or test fixture.
turns: Call get_leave_balance with employee identity provided and year omitted.
cases.expected_behavior: The tool returns a leave balance response using the default year resolution rather than rejecting the request for a missing optional year.

assertions.description: year is optional and may be omitted

cases.name: get_leave_balance accepts explicit null year as optional input
cases.objective: Verify get_leave_balance treats an explicit null year as equivalent to omission for the optional year field.
preconditions: A valid employee identity is available to the harness or test fixture.
turns: Call get_leave_balance with employee identity provided and year explicitly set to null.
cases.expected_behavior: The tool returns a leave balance response and does not fail validation solely because year is null.

assertions.description: Explicit null is accepted for optional year

cases.name: get_leave_balance rejects missing employee identity without trusted identity
cases.objective: Verify get_leave_balance requires an employee identity when no trusted identity is available and returns a clear argument/authorization failure.
turns: Call get_leave_balance with year omitted and without providing any employee identity, and without a trusted identity context.
cases.expected_behavior: The tool refuses the request because the required employee identity is missing and no trusted identity is present.

assertions.description: Employee identity is required when trusted identity is absent
Request is denied or rejected due to missing identity
